# Vendored from trutohq/elaichi-skills — do not edit here

`elaichi.mdc` in this directory is a **copy** of the rule generated in
[trutohq/elaichi-skills](https://github.com/trutohq/elaichi-skills) (itself
generated there from `skills/elaichi-conventions/SKILL.md` — see that repo's
`scripts/generate-rule.mjs`). Do not hand-edit it here. Run
`node scripts/sync-skills.mjs` in this repo to pull the latest copy in.

Direction of copy: `elaichi-skills` → `elaichi-cursor-plugin`, always.
